content: Tisu in'jan'choma anttepa fuiteya'cho

Majan a'ija Cristove in'ja'an'qque toya tise'pa injama'choi'ccu pa'tssima in'jan'fambi. Tsa'cansi quinsetssia tsu quin'su mechoama fuiteya'cho. Ingija ñoa'me Cristove in'jamba tisu in'jan'choma anttepa tsendeccuma mende'yepa fuiteya'cho.
Tisu faenga'su in'janqquia'caen tsu tson'faya'cho tisema fuiteye. Nane tise'pama tsa'caen fuiteye osha'ta tsu tsa'caen ñotsse tsoña'cho cuintsu tise'pa'qque ti'tsse Jesúsve in'jan'faye.
Cristo'qque tisu in'jan'chove tsombi. Tsa'ma Chiga Tevaen'jen suqquia'caen tiseja qquen afa: “Chiga Quitsa, cca'indeccuja quema chi'gapa ñama tsu afase'fa.”
Pa'tssi osha'cho tayopi Chiga su'choma tsu tevaen'fa ingima atesiañe. Tsama camba gi qque'faya'bi. Avujatsse Chiga su'chove in'jamba gi ronda'je'fa tsa'caen daya'chove.

Chiga tsu ingima in'jaen cuintsu qquembe'yi avujatsse Tise've in'jan'faye. Ña'qque in'jan cuintsu Chiga que'ima ti'tsse in'jaensi que'i poiyi'cco Jesucristo in'janqquia'caen fae'ngae avujatsse canse'faye.
Tsa'caen fae'ngae avujatsse cansepa qui fae aya'fa'caen Chiga Quitsama ñotsse afa'faya. Nane Chigaja ñoa'me ingi Na'su Jesucristo Quitsa tsu.
Ñotsse condase'choma israembindeqquianga condase
“Chigaja ti'tsse'tssia” qquen canjaeñe in'jamba Cristoja ingima ttu'sepa in'jan. Tsa'caen ingi'qque tisupapora ttu'sepa injancco'faya'cho.
Ña gi que'inga conda: Chigaja tayopi'su israe coenzandeccunga Cristo jiya'chone condase. Jesúsja tsa Cristo tsu. Tiseja ji israendeccuma fuitepa Chigaja tansintsse afa'su qquen canjaeñe.

Toya'caen tsu israembindeqquianga canjaeñe ji Chigaja tise'pama'qque mende'yepa in'jan'chove. Tsama in'jan'da tsu israembindeqquiaja “Chigaja ti'tsse'tssia” qquen su'faya. Nane Chiga Tevaen'jenga tayopi'su Davidja qquen su:
Toya'caen cca'ttinga tsu su:
Toya'caen:

content.text: Nane poiyi'cco aindeccu, Tisema ñotsse afa'faja.

content: Toya'caen Isaíasja su:

content.text: Tise dutssi'ye'su tsu na'suja jiya israembindeqquia na'suve daye.

content: Chiga ingima in'jaensi gi avujatsse ronda'je'fa. Ñajan in'jan cuintsu Tise tsa'caen que'ima in'jaensi Tise've in'jamba avujatsse opatsse canse'faye. Nane Chiga Qquendya'pa tsa'caen que'ima in'jaen'ninda qui Chigave ti'tsse ro'ndá can'jen'faya.
Ña in'jan'cho faengasundeccu, in'jan gi que'ija osha'cho ñotssiama tson'jen'fa. Osha'choma qui atesu'fa. Tisupapora qui ñotsse candusiancco'fa.
Tsa'ma va tevaen'jenga dyombi'tsse gi tansintsse que'inga condase ma'caen canse'faye. Tsa'caen gi condase que'i aqque'pa'fasa'ne. Nane Chiga Quitsa tsu ñama in'jaemba ttu'se

cuintsu tsa'caen israembindeqquianga'qque Jesucristone condaseye. Chiga ccushaen'chone ñotsse condase'choma gi candusian'jen cuintsu Chiga Qquendya'pa tise'pama in'jaeñe. Tsa'caen in'jaensi tsu tisupama Chiganga afe'faya. Afesi Chigaja suya: “Que'ija ño'a'fa qui.”
Ñajan Jesucristove in'jamba gi Chiga sema'bama sema'jen. Tsa'caen sema'jemba gi avujatsse afaye osha.
Tsa'ma Jesucristo ñama in'jaensi sema'jen'choveyi gi condase. Tise ñama in'jaensi gi ña aya'fai'ccu, ña tson'choi'ccu israembindeqquiama in'jaen cuintsu tise'pa'qque Chigama paña'faye.

Chiga Qquendya'pa tsu ñama oshaen cuintsu agattoen'choi'ccu osha'cho canjaen'choi'ccu Cristone ñotsse condase'choma condaseye. Nane Jerusaléne ashaemba já Ilírico andeni japa gi pa'ccoma tansintsse condase.

Ñoa'me gi in'jan toya pañambindeqquianga Cristo ccushaen'chone condaseye. Nane faesu tsaoña'jemba anttesi tsa ashaen'chonga tsao'ñaqquia'caen in'jambi gi faesu atesiansi tayo paña'chondeccunga condaseye.
Nane Chiga Tevaen'jen suqquia'caen:
Pablo Roma canqqueni jaye in'jan
Tsa'caen toya pañambindeqquianga condase'jepa gi tsain'bitsse que'ini jiye in'jan'ma oshambi.
Tsa'ma ja'ño gi vani'su sema'bama tayo nani. Tsain'bitssi canqque'fa que'ini pasia'su jiye in'jamba
gi ja'ño Españani jaye tson'jemba que'ima'qque atteya qquen asi'ttaen. Tsa'caen que'i'ccu avujatsse can'jenccapa jayisi qui que'ija ñama fuitepa camoen'faya ña Españani jaye.
Tsa'ma ja'ñonda gi Jerusaléni jaya'cho tseni'su Cristove in'jan'chondeccuma fuiteye.
Nane Macedoniasundeccu, Acayasundeccu'qque fuiteye in'jamba corifin'dima boña'fa Jerusaléni'su Cristove in'jan'cho va'chandeccunga moemba fuiteye.

Nane tise'paja ñotsse asi'ttaemba tsu tsa'caen tsoñe in'jan'fa. Ñoa'me ñotssi tsu tise'pa tsa'caen israendeccuma tsoñe. Nane israendeccuja me'ttia'ye Cristove in'jamba israembindeqquianga conda'fa cuintsu tise'pa'qque in'jan'faye. Tsa'cansi ccane'qque ñotssi tsu israembindeqquia osha'choma an'bian'da tsai'ccu israendeccuma fuite'faye.
Tsonsi ñajan va afe'cho corifin'dima angapa afepa gi Españani jaye somboya. Tseni jayipa gi que'ini pasiá jaya.
Ñoa'me gi in'jan ña que'ini jipa condasesi tsu Cristoja que'ima ñoa'me ñotsse tsoña.

Faengasundeccu, que'i'qque qui ingi Na'su Jesucristove in'jan'fa. Tise qquendya'pa ingima in'jaensi gi poini injancco'fa. Tsa'camba gi ñajan que'ima iñajan: Ñai'ccu fae'ngae Chigama ñoa'me iñajan'faja

cuintsu ñama ccushaeñe Cristove in'jambi'choa israendeccu ñama indi'fasa'ne. Toya'caen Chigama iñajan'faja cuintsu Jerusaléni'su Cristove in'jan'chondeccu avujatsse ña tise'panga anga afe'cho corifin'dima isu'faye.
Tsa'caen Chiga in'jamba antte'ninda gi avujatsse que'ini jipa ño'fa can'jeña.
In'jan gi Chiga que'i'ccu can'jensi poiyi'cco opatsse dyombe'yi can'jen'faye. Tsangaeyi.
